setup.title: Set up the company
setup.intro: This is the first start. Name the company and yourself. You will be the owner and log in with your name and password from now on.
setup.language_hint: The handbook and the presets for employees are created in this language, and the employees write into the files of the company in it. At first it also applies to your web UI; you can change that later on your own page.
setup.name: Your name
setup.display_name: How the team addresses you (optional, e.g. your first name)
setup.after: Afterwards you set the Claude token and, if you like, services. Then you hire your first employees, e.g. HR from a preset.
settings.name: Name of the company
settings.name_hint: It is at the top left of every page next to “Ancroo Crew”, in the browser tab and in the prompts of the employees.
settings.claim_hint: An optional short line below the name of the company, at most {size} characters. Leave it empty for none. It is not shown on a phone.
settings.language_hint: The employees write into the files of the company in this language: profiles, journal, transcripts, feedback proposals. In a conversation they still answer in the language of the human. What is already written stays as it is: you translate the handbook and the profiles yourself.
settings.logo_none: No logo yet. Then only the name is shown.
settings.logo_remove_question: Remove the logo? Then only the name is shown.
settings.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most {size} KB. It is shown at the top left before the name, on the login page too. SVG is not accepted, because an SVG can contain scripts.
settings.sandbox_on: Show the limits of every run on the page “Sandbox”
settings.sandbox_hint: For a demo or for checking the limits: every run appears live with what it may read, write and use. Only paths inside the container and the names of tool calls are shown, no conversations. Nothing is stored; switching off empties the page.
settings.software_hint: The top left always says “Ancroo Crew” with the anchor: the name of the software this installation runs on. Your company is shown next to it. Name, claim and logo are yours; the name Ancroo and the anchor logo are not part of your settings.
about.title: About Ancroo Crew
about.intro: Ancroo Crew is a web UI for a company of AI employees. Every employee is a folder of text files, and every run starts Claude Code in a short-lived Docker container.
about.author: Author
about.modified: with changes that were not committed yet
about.version_unknown: Unknown: this installation was not built with deploy.
about.license_text: Ancroo Crew is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 (AGPLv3). You may use, change and share it. Whoever runs a changed version on a network must offer its source code to the people who use it.
about.source_text: The source code is public on GitHub:
about.security_text: Please not as a public issue, but through the private reporting on GitHub:
login.title: Log in
login.name: Name
team.no_employees: Nobody yet. Start with HR from a preset; HR then leads the hiring interviews.
team.no_token: The Claude token is missing, no employee can work yet. Set it here:
team.roles_hint: Roles decide who does which job. You assign them on the card of an employee under “Change key facts”.
team.role_missing.hr: nobody – without HR there are no hiring interviews and no feedback meetings
team.role_missing.reviewer: nobody – without reviewers there is no assessment
team.role_missing.archivist: nobody – earlier conversations stay hidden for everyone
team.archive_hint: Dismissed employees and discarded drafts. The folders are in the company's folder archive.
card.name: Name
card.title: Job title
card.header_hint: This changes the header of the profile and is committed to Git. A name must be unique in the company. A service allows all its tools, service__tool only that one.
card.assessment_since: The assessment has been running since {time}. That takes a few minutes; the progress updates by itself.
card.feedback_since: The feedback meeting has been running since {time}. That takes a few minutes; the progress updates by itself.
card.discard_question: Discard the draft for {name}? The folder moves to the archive.
card.assessment_employee_hint: In the assessment the ticked reviewers play through up to {n} situations with {name} that rarely come up in everyday work: limits under pressure, rare rules, rules that collide, and gaps. They measure against the handbook, core and way of working. The profile does not change; the reports go into the next feedback meeting.
card.dismiss_question: Really dismiss {name}? The folder moves to the archive.
card.dismiss_hint: If it does not fit: the folder of {name} moves to the archive with profile, conversations and feedback. The conversations stay in the database. From the archive {name} can be rehired.
card.requests_hint: What {name} would have needed in a conversation but was not allowed to use. “Approve” adds the tool to the field services of the profile and commits the change to Git.
card.too_long: , more than the {limit} allowed. The next feedback meeting shortens it
card.evaluation_ready: The evaluation of {date} is ready. Your decision is missing.
card.no_leader: There is nobody in the team who can lead the feedback meeting of {name}. Give someone the role HR, or adapt the profile through “Edit”.
card.brief_placeholder: For example: the answers have become too long for me.
card.feedback_hint: {name} reads the agreement and the latest conversations, assignments and review reports since the last meeting and proposes changes to core and way of working, with a section for you. You get one page and decide: accept, edit or reject.
card.feedback_hr_hint: {name} cannot lead their own feedback meeting, so {leader} does it.
card.no_schedules: None. Here you set what {name} shall do by themselves.
card.schedule_placeholder: For example: put my day together, appointments and open tasks.
card.schedule_hint: At the time the task goes to {name} as a message on your behalf, with services connected. The answer is in the chat; the conversation ends by itself like any other and is recorded.
card.edits_hint: What humans changed in the files of {name} through “Edit”. That does not count as feedback on the work.
chat.title: Chat with {name}
chat.empty: Nothing written yet. The first message begins a new conversation with {name}.
chat.empty_hiring: Write {name} what you need someone for. {name} asks until the role is clear and creates the draft as a candidate at the end.
chat.to_title: Bring a colleague into the conversation. They read it and answer once.
chat.key_hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line.
chat.send_failed: The message could not be sent.
chat.reopen_failed: The conversation could not be continued.
conv.title: Conversations with {name}
conv.ask_archivist: Whoever wants to know something about the content of earlier conversations asks the archivist,
fb.title: Feedback meeting {name}
fb.busy: A job is still running for {name}. You can decide as soon as it is done.
fb.header_changed: {name} also changed the header of the profile. The header stays as it is; only the text is taken over.
fb.changes: Changes to the profile in detail
fb.changes_hint: Struck through is what goes, highlighted in green what comes. The comparison is with the profile as it is now.
fb.accept_hint_no_profile: “Accept” closes the meeting without a change to the profile.
fb.decision_hint: “Reject” leaves the profile as it is. The decision is committed to Git.
fb.no_difference: No difference to the current profile.
fb.reject_question: Reject the proposal? The profile stays as it is.
edit.title: Edit {path}
edit.hint: You change the file yourself, bypassing the feedback meeting. The change is in the log of {name} afterwards but does not count as feedback on the work.
edit.header_stays: The header of the profile with model, tools and status stays as it is.
edit.handbook_hint: The handbook applies to everyone in the team and is in every prompt. The change applies from the next run on.
edit.about_hint: What all employees know about you. It is in every prompt.
edit.reason_hint: {name} reads kind and reason in the next conversation. So do not write the removed details into the reason.
edit.no_difference: No difference to the earlier version.
person.about_hint: This text is in every prompt.
person.name: Name
person.name_hint: You log in with your name or with the name the team addresses you by. Both must be unique in the company. The language applies to the web UI and to your conversations.
person.password_hint: After setting it you log in again.
handbook.title: Handbook
svc.token_set.subscription: A token of the subscription is set (from claude setup-token).
svc.token_missing: No token set. No employee can work yet.
svc.token_hint: Every run starts Claude Code with this token. It is stored with mode 600 next to the company and is never shown again. A new token replaces the old one.
svc.name: Name
svc.description: Description (HR reads it in the hiring interview)
svc.blocked_comma: Tools blocked for everyone, comma separated
svc.header_value: Value of the header (empty keeps the stored one)
svc.hint: An employee gets a service through the field services on their card. Secrets are stored with mode 600 and are never shown again. Employees cannot read them.
svc.network: Runs are in the Docker network {network}: attach the MCP services to it and give their container name as address.
svc.delete_question: Delete this service? Employees who have it in their profile can no longer start a conversation until you remove it there.
hire.title: Hire from a preset
hire.intro: A preset is a profile for a typical role. You choose one, adapt it and hire without interview and assessment. You can also paste an existing profile.
hire.interview_hint: For a new role of your own, the hiring interview with HR is the better way:
hire.own_hint: Paste an existing profile, e.g. from another company.
hire.form_hint: The name must be unique in the company. Core and way of working are what the employee is told; a profile pasted in one piece into the core is split by its headings. Both get sharper in the work.
archive.title: Archive: {name}
archive.rehire_question: Rehire {name}? The folder comes back into the team with all files.
archive.rehire_hint: {name} comes back as {name} left: with profile, conversations and the status of back then.
search.title: Search
search.heading: Search the files
search.placeholder: Search a text in all files …
search.label: Search text
search.hint: Searches the folders of all employees and candidates. Conversations in the database and earlier versions in Git are not included.
search.too_short: Please enter at least three characters.
notices.heading: Notices from the employees
notices.hint: Here are notes employees left for you at the end of an answer, e.g. the result of a recurring task. The whole answer is in the conversation.
usage.heading: Tokens used
usage.none: There are no booked runs in this period.
usage.api_hint: With the subscription this amount is not charged. It shows what the same runs would have cost at API prices, as Claude Code calculates them.
usage.chart_label: Tokens per day; the tables below give the numbers
usage.prompt_hint: The procedure is the file from app/procedures that ends the prompt. The purpose says what the run was for: an asked colleague, for example, runs with the procedure conversation.
sys.ask_nobody: {name} wanted to ask “{target}”. There is nobody for that in the team.
sys.ask_web_archivist: {name} wanted to ask {archivist}. Whoever reads on the web gets no information from the archive.
sys.ask_web_after_archive: {name} wanted to ask {target}. Once the archive has been consulted in a conversation, nobody in it asks a colleague who reads on the web.
sys.busy: {name} is busy right now and did not answer.
sys.not_approved: Not approved: {tools}. You can approve it on the [card]({url}). Then ask again.
sys.candidate_created: Candidate created: [{name}](/team/{id}). The card continues with the assessment.
sys.git_failed: The files are written, but the Git commit failed: {error}
sys.end_failed: Conversation ended. Something went wrong while closing it: {error}
job.probe_waiting: conversation {n} of {of}: waiting for the answer to message {turn}
job.probe_deciding: conversation {n} of {of}: decides whether to follow up
job.not_shortened: evaluation ready, the profile is not shortened: {error}
hint.archived: The folder is in the archive
file.edits_intro: What humans changed themselves in the files of this folder through the web UI. These are no feedback on the work of the colleague.
file.track_intro: How the owner decided on the proposals since {since}. Compiled by the service. “Edited by hand” means: the proposal was changed before it was accepted. Rejected means: nothing of it was taken over.
file.transcript_intro: Recorded by the service. Conversation no. {cid}.
file.assignment_title: Assignment of {date} in the conversation of {person} with {employee}
file.assignment_intro: Recorded by the service, not by {name}. Conversation no. {cid},
file.question: Question
file.reviews_intro: Added by the service after each assessment: which rule each review conversation tested and whether it held.

err.already_decided: This feedback meeting is already decided.

err.still_candidate: {name} is still a candidate. Conversations come after hiring.

err.conversation_ending: The conversation is ending right now. Please wait a moment.

err.bring_in_only_conversation: Colleagues can be brought only into a normal conversation.
err.reopen_only_ended: Only an ended conversation can be continued.

err.time_form: The time has the form HH:MM.
err.channel_off: The channel is not set up. It needs COMPANY_CHANNEL_TOKEN.

card.self_edit_label: {name} may change the own profile; the changes apply at once
card.candidate_text: {name} is a draft from the hiring interview. Read profile and agreement below and change them if you like. Then hire or discard.
card.candidate_hint: Hiring makes {name} an employee. The profile does not have to be perfect: it gets better in the work. An assessment can be started on the card afterwards, e.g. before {name} gets web access or services.
card.versions_hint: Every change of the profile is in Git. A version shows what changed and can be restored.
card.profile_hint_yes: {name} changes the own profile in conversations: when you say how to do something from now on, or when something clearly went wrong. You see every change in the chat and can undo it there; older ones under “Versions”.
card.profile_hint_no: {name} proposes changes to the own profile in conversations. You accept or discard them in the chat.
card.agreement_hint: What {name} is there for and how you notice that it is worth it. HR writes it in the hiring interview, you can change it here. The feedback meeting measures the work by it. {name} does not get it in the prompt.
card.not_assessed: {name} has web access or services and has never been assessed.
version.title: {name}: profile of {when}
version.heading: Version of the profile ({what})
version.changes: Changes compared with the version before
version.no_changes: The text did not change in this version.
version.restore_question: Put the text of {when} back into the profile of {name} ({what})? The header stays as it is.
version.restore_hint: Restoring changes only the text below the header. It is logged as your edit, so {name} learns of it in the next conversation.
profile.note.proposed: proposes a change to the own profile ({what})
profile.note.too_long: change to the profile not saved ({what}): the text would be too long
profile.note.accepted: proposed change to the profile accepted ({what})
profile.note.discarded: proposed change to the profile discarded ({what})
file.own_change_of: Own change of {name} to the profile ({what}, {state})
sys.profile_header_kept: {name} changed the header of the profile. The service put it back: name, title, model, tools, services and roles only a human changes.
err.self_edit_value: Own changes to the profile: “yes” or “no”.
err.unknown_profile_change: There is no such change to a profile.
err.profile_change_decided: This change has been decided already.
err.profile_changed_since: The profile has changed since. The versions on the card show what applies.
err.unknown_version: There is no version {version} of this profile.
err.assessment_candidate: {name} is a draft. The assessment comes after hiring, on the card of the employee.
card.parts_hint: The core (task, personality, limits) holds what no single conversation shall change; it has at most {core} words and changes seldom. The way of working holds what has shown in the work: rules, methods, facts. It may grow up to {work} words, but every change merges instead of appending. What applies to everyone is in the handbook, not here.
hire.work_text: Way of working: rules, methods, facts
sandbox.intro: Every run of an employee is a short-lived container. This page shows, for the last runs, the limits it was started with, read from the real Docker command, from the outside in.
sandbox.off: The sandbox view is off. Switch it on in the settings.
sandbox.no_runs: No run yet. Write to an employee, and the run appears here.
sandbox.why.container: A fresh container per run, removed afterwards, on a network of its own and with limited memory.
sandbox.why.files: Mounts decide what can be read or changed, not the prompt. Hidden folders are covered by an empty tmpfs.
sandbox.why.tools: Claude Code gets only these tools. Bash is never given; the rules below block the token, the histories and the service tokens.
sandbox.why.services: Only in a conversation with a human and only for whoever has them in their profile. The tokens stay out of reach.
sandbox.mount.protected: read only – exception in the own folder
